highlights.description: 将地图作为空间条件（spatial map tokens）注入单机器人轨迹扩散骨干网络，并与既有多机器人协调器（如XECBS分解）组合，实现跨布局泛化。
highlights.excerpt:
In this paper, we present
Spatially Conditioned Trajectory Diffusion
(SCTD), a
single-robot
highlights.transferability: 可迁移到其他需要地图条件化的扩散规划器或其他多机器人协调框架
highlights.limitation: 片段仅给出思路框架，缺乏完整机制细节对比

highlights.description: 在未见地图上比较冻结/微调编码器与全局嵌入基线，并报告Success@1与Success@64的消融与分组结果。
highlights.excerpt:
Table
3
shows that SCTD outperforms the global embedding across all reported task groups with both frozen and fine-tuned encoders. The advantage is especially pronounced on tasks requiring obstacle avoidance: on hard-detour tasks, the fine-tuned SCTD achieves 73.7% Success@1 and 97.5% Success@64
highlights.transferability: Success@J指标与冻结/微调消融可复用于其他条件化规划器评估
highlights.limitation: 片段未给出基线具体数值，需要完整表格

highlights.description: 两阶段训练流程：先用占用图与符号距离目标预训练地图编码器（无需轨迹演示），再联合训练编码器与时间去噪器；采样时对干净轨迹做裁剪。
highlights.excerpt:
This stage uses occupancy maps and signed-distance targets without
trajectory demonstrations. The query head is then discarded, and the
pretrained stem initializes the map encoder
highlights.transferability: 无演示预训练+联合微调的流程可迁移到其他地图条件扩散模型
highlights.limitation: 片段未报告预训练对最终性能的定量贡献
